scope: episodic objective viability only; separate inference-time development; core v6 unchanged

trainables.implementation: torch.func.functional_call(model,{name:master.to(bfloat16)},strict=False,tie_weights=True); all actual model parameters requires_grad False; only enumerated fp32 masters require grad
trainables.final_decode: copy masters rounded bf16 into exact LN names only; decode ordinary frozen-model path; restore original bf16 bytes in finally

optimization.reset: new masters and optimizer from exact theta0 each objective/utterance; no optimizer/cache/gradient state transfer; reset actual bf16 LN, verify exact hash and flags; all other parameters immutable

teacher_forcing.input: cB+y; no appended EOS; explicit IDs (no labels auto-shift), use_cache=False, no past KV; ordinary detached non-inference encoder outputs reused
teacher_forcing.target_query: content token t predicted by raw logits at absolute decoder index3+t for t=0..T-1; final query3+T reports EOS probability only
teacher_forcing.suppression: generation_config.suppress_tokens all content positions, begin_suppress_tokens at t0 only; float32 log_softmax on finite allowed vocabulary, no 0*(-inf)
teacher_forcing.teacher_special_handling: preserve generated content IDs including UTF8 fragments; strip only verified initial AUTO prompt/terminal EOS if present; unexpected interior control IDs INVALID; no text retokenization
teacher_forcing.valid_positions: fixed from theta0 teacher: non-special content ID AND target not suppressed at t; log exclusions/counts; same loss mask for both steps
teacher_forcing.cap: use complete frozen prefix up to200 generated content IDs even if capped; do not invent EOS target
teacher_forcing.empty: exactly2 no-op AdamW steps with scalar zero connected to masters and zero gradients; log no_valid_content, loss0; final baseline identity; no drop/refill
teacher_forcing.encoder: one original frozen encoder per utterance, detached clone outside inference_mode; no encoder recomputation during objectives; no encoder grads/cache carry

A1.name: GREEDY_EM
A1.teacher: theta0 B0_FORCED generated content IDs only, sealed before updates
A1.loss: mean over fixed valid content t of -sum over allowed v p_t(v)*log p_t(v); all predictive allowed tokens including EOS; no CE/pseudo-label term

A2.name: AUTO_CONSISTENCY
A2.teacher: theta0 ordinary AUTO content IDs only, detached and sealed before updates
A2.loss: mean over fixed valid content t of -log p_t(y_A[t]); no mix/regularizer/lambda/second teacher

decode.forced_path: existing cached.Branch.step(cB then one token), capture_layer=16 PASSIVE recorder, attention=True, processed_argmax, no action hook; audit theta0 token equality vs P2SEQ S0
decode.runtime_failure: nonfinite loss/grad/master/effective params/logits or reset/provider/path mismatch =>INVALID and STOP; do not change clipping/LR/precision

reuse.forced: reuse exact20 P2SEQ S0 after hash/model/feature/env/path CPU audit; same allocation theta0 no-hook decoder must reproduce tokens/EOS for all20 before adaptation; mismatch =>INVALID, no silent baseline replacement
reuse.auto: reuse exact20 historical AUTO through existing P2SEQ proof, exact snapshot/env/audio/provider hash identity; missing proof =>block before job, no new AUTO scientific generation
reuse.pseudo_seal: CPU results/inference_cf/p2tta0/pseudo_sealed.json pushed before adaptation; IDs/teacher token lists/EOS/cap/row/manifest/model hashes, no references

logging.losses: L0,L1,L2 on same teacher/mask; two backwards/steps, third loss forward no update
logging.parameters: fp32 master L2/relative delta, effective bf16 delta/changed scalar count, global pre-step fp32 grad L2, finite flags
logging.common_teacher_diagnostics: theta0 B0_FORCED y_B fixed positions for pre/after both objectives: entropy, script P_E/P_M and EOS probabilities including final query; float32 processed vocabulary; not objective/selection feature except stated EM confirmation-bias diagnostic
logging.endings: generated content length/EOS/cap; severe truncation if B0 length>=10 AND adapted EOS length<=floor(0.5*B0 length); caps separately
logging.differences: token Levenshtein distance vs B0_FORCED and AUTO, exact equality/first difference; no sampled candidates
logging.no_large_results: compact scalars and per-position summary arrays; optional compressed tiny LN/master checkpoints ~1MB per objective/utterance for independent audit, no activations/KV/full vocabulary dumps

metrics: P2SEQ lexical outside-POI edits/harm with counts

decision.useful: net POI reduction>=2 OR >=3 utterances have fewer mixed errors than forced AND improved count>degraded count; ties not improvements
decision.safety: all point safety bounds, no new severe truncation; empty baseline-correct rate denominator=>None and explicitly not assessable/vacuous bound; nonempty primary reference language populations required
decision.EM_confirmation_bias: A1 token-weighted corpus mean entropy on fixed y_B valid positions decreases>=1% from initial AND any MER/ZH/retention/outside/corruption/truncation/cap safety bound fails; distinct from no-gain; not automatic for entropy-only shrinkage
decision.selection: only viable =>select; neither =>NO_VIABLE; both lexicographically lower corpus MER, PIER, ZH-CER, mean per-utterance fp32-master update L2; tolerance1e-12 per float tie, then fixed A2 (problem-specific) exact tie

uncertainty.unit: 20 sorted dialogues one utterance each, paired draws
uncertainty.CI: 95% pointwise percentile of corpus count-sum ratios; descriptive only, no significance gate; omit empty denominator draws, disclose counts

audit.independence: must not import primary decision; own metric aggregation/selection/bootstrap; may share locked canonical primitives
audit.reset: bf16 LN theta0 bitwise and fp32 masters exactly theta0.float each objective start; end after each objective and final session; all non-LN no grads/updates, optimizer discarded
audit.objective_math: Mandatory FIRST panel utterance theta0 both objectives: independent loss formula/backward; abs loss<=1e-5; norm(g_primary-g_auditor)<=max(1e-8,1e-3*norm(g_auditor)), evaluated on complete fp32 master-gradient vectors; no extra optimizer updates; CPU sums saved entropy/logtarget and mask counts independently

compute.exhaustion: preserve partial/INVALID and STOP, no second job

next.selected: STOP evidence handoff P2_TTA0_TTA1_HANDOFF.md for separately frozen100-utterance TTA1; no TTA1 execution
next.invalid: STOP engineering-only correction preserving attempt, no scientific changes

allowed: existing fixed100 panel and inference_cf artifacts

github: check/test -> inspect diff -> commit -> push origin HEAD:cs-asr-steer-inf; freeze/pseudo seal/resolved manifest/preaudit remote before scientific outcome; no force/main merge/PR
